styles.name: Flat geometric
styles.look: Circles, rectangles and triangles in a tight palette, no outlines, crisp edges, objects reduced to their simplest shapes.

traits.fill: flat, 3-5 colours
traits.shading: none, or one darker offset shape
traits.simplification: people as geometric bodies without faces; objects as 3-6 primitives

styles.name: Monoline
styles.look: One even stroke weight and round caps; every drawing is a single continuous-feeling line with no fills.

traits.stroke: single weight, round caps and joins
traits.fill: none, optional one accent fill
traits.simplification: people as a few lines; objects as outline only

styles.name: Hand-inked line with hatching
styles.look: Pen drawing with slightly wobbly outlines and cross-hatching for shade on a paper tone.

traits.stroke: varied weight, heavier on the shaded side
traits.fill: paper colour plus one ink
traits.simplification: people with simple faces and clothing folds; objects with visible construction

banned: more than one ink plus paper

styles.name: Risograph two-colour print
styles.look: Two spot inks that overprint into a third, visible grain and slight misregistration, flat shapes on cream paper.

traits.fill: two inks and their overlap, multiply blend
traits.simplification: bold blobby shapes; faces minimal

styles.name: Paper-cut layers
styles.look: Stacked flat shapes with soft drop shadows between layers, as if cut from coloured card.

traits.fill: flat card colours, one per layer
traits.simplification: rounded, torn-edge silhouettes; people as simple cut shapes

styles.name: Isometric
styles.look: Objects and spaces drawn on a 30-degree grid with three tone faces, clean edges and no perspective distortion.

traits.fill: flat three-tone per object (top, left, right)
traits.simplification: tiny people as peg figures; objects as extruded modules

styles.name: Blueprint technical drawing
styles.look: White or pale lines on a deep blue field: dimension lines, section hatching, callouts and a title block.

traits.stroke: fine, even, with dimension and centre lines
traits.fill: none; hatch for cut surfaces
traits.simplification: orthographic views; people only as scale figures

styles.name: Woodcut and linocut
styles.look: Bold black carved shapes with gouge marks and white lines cut out of solid ink, on a paper tone.

traits.fill: solid ink and paper
traits.simplification: heavy silhouettes; faces as a few cuts

banned: more than one ink plus an optional spot colour

styles.name: Collage and cut-out
styles.look: Torn and scissor-cut shapes in mixed textures and colours, overlapping with offset shadows, tape and stitching.

traits.stroke: none, or a stitched dashed line
traits.fill: mixed flat colours and patterned paper
traits.simplification: figures assembled from a few cut pieces

styles.name: Pixel art
styles.look: A visible low-resolution grid with limited palette and hard edges, scaled up with no smoothing.

traits.fill: indexed palette of 8-16 colours
traits.simplification: sprites on a 16 or 32 pixel grid

styles.name: Soft clay shading
styles.look: Rounded, puffy forms with soft gradients, highlights and gentle shadows, like matte clay or vinyl toys.

traits.fill: soft gradients in one hue family per object
traits.simplification: chunky rounded bodies, dot eyes

styles.name: Halftone duotone
styles.look: Subjects built from a dot screen in one ink on a contrasting field, big dots, newspaper-like.

traits.fill: dot screen with a visible angle
traits.simplification: high-contrast shapes; faces dissolved into dots

styles.name: Mid-century catalogue
styles.look: Mid-century catalogue and magazine drawing: simplified shapes with off-register colour, small tidy details and a warm limited palette.

traits.stroke: thin, partial outlines offset from the fill
traits.fill: flat, muted warm palette, offset from the line
traits.shading: none, or a darker flat shape
traits.simplification: elongated, stylised people; objects as neat symbols

styles.name: Sticker and badge
styles.look: Chunky shapes with a thick white or dark die-cut border, glossy flat colour and a small drop shadow, like a sticker sheet.

traits.stroke: thick uniform outline plus a die-cut border
traits.fill: saturated flat colour
traits.simplification: round faces, big eyes allowed, tiny hands

styles.name: Crayon and child-drawn
styles.look: Waxy, uneven strokes and wobbly shapes that fill unevenly, as if drawn by a child with crayons.

traits.fill: scribbled with paper showing through
traits.simplification: stick limbs, round heads, naive perspective

styles.name: Editorial cartoon
styles.look: Expressive ink caricature with varied line, exaggerated proportions, a spot of watercolour-like colour and a witty idea.

traits.fill: limited flat tones, loose colour offset from the line
traits.simplification: exaggerated heads and gestures; objects as props

styles.name: Cartographic
styles.look: Map language: contour lines, hachures, graticules, compass roses and small pictorial symbols with a tidy legend.

traits.stroke: fine contour and road lines in 2-3 weights
traits.fill: pale land, water and green tints
traits.simplification: buildings as footprints; people as route markers

styles.name: Infographic diagram
styles.look: Clean explanatory graphics: numbered steps, arrows, labelled parts and simple pictograms on a consistent grid.

traits.fill: flat, two or three semantic colours
traits.simplification: pictograms for people and objects; real labels

styles.name: Stamp and letterpress
styles.look: Rubber-stamp and letterpress marks: one ink, rough edges, circular text, rules, ornaments and slightly uneven pressure.

traits.fill: one ink, uneven coverage
traits.simplification: emblems, seals and ornaments instead of scenes

styles.name: Neon line on dark
styles.look: Thin glowing coloured lines on a near-black ground, like neon tubes or a night-time interface.

traits.stroke: even, rounded, with a soft glow
traits.fill: none; dark ground
traits.simplification: outline pictograms; people as figures in light

styles.name: Watercolour wash
styles.look: Soft translucent washes with bleeding edges and paper white left showing, with an optional loose pencil line.

traits.fill: layered translucent blobs with darker edges
traits.simplification: impressionistic figures, no detail in faces

banned: heavy filter stacks that exceed the size budget

styles.name: Architectural line drawing
styles.look: Precise elevation and plan drawings in fine black lines with a little hatch, entourage trees and people as thin figures.

traits.fill: white, with occasional poche
traits.simplification: figures as thin silhouettes; materials as hatch patterns

styles.name: Retro screenprint poster
styles.look: Stacked flat colour planes with stepped tones, gradients made of bands, and a strong focal shape.

traits.fill: 4-6 flat inks with banded steps
traits.simplification: bold simple masses; figures as silhouettes

styles.name: Scribble sketch
styles.look: Quick loose pencil or marker scribbles with overlapping lines and a few flat colour blocks as highlight.

traits.fill: a single colour block per drawing
traits.simplification: gestural figures
